summary: Proxy ứng dụng đám mây mã nguồn mở, hoạt động như reverse proxy và load balancer cho microservice và container.
usecases: Route traffic to microservices in Kubernetes clusters
Provide secure external access to internal services via TLS/Let's Encrypt
Dynamic configuration updates for changing service topologies
ideas: Combine with service mesh for zero-downtime deployments
Deploy as edge proxy for internal service mesh traffic
Automate TLS certificate management for dynamic microservice discovery
